tldr: The Sun in Libra: identity built through relationship, balance, and ethical choice.
body: With the Sun in Libra, the core self strengthens through partnership, beauty, fairness, and the ability to consider more than one side. You are here to create harmony without losing your own center.
gift: Diplomacy, charm, fairness, social intelligence, and partnership skill.
challenge: People-pleasing, indecision, and mistaking approval for peace.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
